title: Polli gets more comfortable in a terminal
summary:
Polli gained audio playback and default text streaming, model prices got clearer, and two community apps joined the greenhouse.

The polli CLI adds `gen audio --play` for playing generated speech or music after saving it. Interactive `gen text` now streams by default, while pipes and redirects still receive buffered output. The default voice changes to sage, terminal formatting is tidier, and a new skill helps record video demos.

The model registry now separates public prices from costs for usage billing and Enter’s pricing table. Gemini Search token prices match Gemini Fast, while Seedream and Wan have explicit image and per-second video and audio prices. Models without an explicit price keep their existing rates.

The app catalog added @Aavirash’s Flashlearn for document-based flashcards and audio lessons, and @Naruto859’s mobile-first assistant Ciel AI. The README showcase also corrected creator credits for kre8.info and IntraMind / AlessiaBot.

highlights.title: Play audio from polli
highlights.text: Use `polli gen audio --play` to save generated speech or music and play it when generation finishes. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Text streams in your terminal
highlights.text: Interactive `polli gen text` now streams by default. Piped output stays buffered, and `--stream` or `--no-stream` lets you choose. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).
